title: Roridin E and satratoxin H, macrocyclic trichothecene mycotoxins, induce endoplasmic reticulum stress-dependent apoptosis through ribosome interaction in B16 mouse melanoma cells.
authors: Lee, Junghyun; Kim, Kyung Ah; Yu, Eunbi; Oh, Sae Woong; Kwon, Kitae; Kim, Gyeonghyeon; Lee, Bum Soo; Ryoo, Rhim; Kim, Ki Hyun; Lee, Jongsung
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌毒素与核糖体互作诱导黑色素瘤细胞凋亡，核心为小分子-核糖体结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Podostroma cornu-damae, commonly known as the red deer's horn mushroom, is a highly toxic species responsible for severe poisonings characterized by vomiting, diarrhea, dehydration, impaired consciousness, and potentially death. This mushroom is notorious for its content of macrocyclic trichothecene mycotoxins. In our ongoing research aimed at discovering bioactive natural compounds, we isolated thirteen macrocyclic trichothecene mycotoxins (P1-P13) from the methanol extract of a plate culture of P. cornu-damae. The chemical structures of these mycotoxins were elucidated through analysis of nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy and high-resolution electrospray ionization mass spectrometry (HR-ESIMS). While macrocyclic trichothecene mycotoxins have previously been reported to exhibit antifungal, antiviral, and anticancer activities, their anti-melanoma effects have not been documented to date. In this study, we examined the cytotoxicity of isolated mycotoxins (P1-P13) against mouse melanoma (B16F10) cells and explored their underlying molecular mechanisms. Among these isolated compounds, P1 (roridin E) and P5 (satratoxin H) exhibited substantial cytotoxicity, demonstrated by dose-dependent inhibition of cell proliferation, increased expression levels of cleaved caspase-3 and Bax, and elevated intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS). Importantly, the cytotoxic effects elicited by roridin E and satratoxin H were significantly attenuated following scavenging of ROS by glutathione (GSH). Additionally, molecular docking analysis indicated high binding affinities of both roridin E and satratoxin H toward ribosomal targets. Treatment with these two mycotoxins led to an increased expression of critical endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress biomarkers, with activation of the unfolded protein response (UPR) signaling pathways involving activating transcription factor 6 (ATF6), protein kinase RNA-like endoplasmic reticulum kinase (PERK), and inositol-requiring enzyme 1 (IRE1). Collectively, our findings suggest that roridin E and satratoxin H induce ER stress-mediated, caspase-dependent apoptosis in melanoma cells. These results highlight the potential of these macrocyclic trichothecene mycotoxins as promising therapeutic candidates for melanoma treatment.
abstract_zh: Podostroma cornu-damae，俗称红鹿角蘑菇，是一种高毒性物种，可导致严重中毒，症状包括呕吐、腹泻、脱水、意识障碍，甚至可能死亡。该蘑菇因其含有大环单端孢霉烯族真菌毒素而臭名昭著。在我们持续寻找生物活性天然化合物的研究中，我们从P. cornu-damae平板培养物的甲醇提取物中分离出十三种大环单端孢霉烯族真菌毒素（P1-P13）。这些真菌毒素的化学结构通过核磁共振（NMR）光谱和高分辨率电喷雾电离质谱（HR-ESIMS）分析得以阐明。尽管大环单端孢霉烯族真菌毒素此前已被报道具有抗真菌、抗病毒和抗癌活性，但其抗黑色素瘤作用至今尚未有文献记载。在本研究中，我们检测了分离的真菌毒素（P1-P13）对小鼠黑色素瘤（B16F10）细胞的细胞毒性，并探讨了其潜在的分子机制。在这些分离的化合物中，P1（roridin E）和P5（satratoxin H）表现出显著的细胞毒性，表现为剂量依赖性抑制细胞增殖、增加裂解型caspase-3和Bax的表达水平，以及提高细胞内活性氧（ROS）水平。重要的是，通过谷胱甘肽（GSH）清除ROS后，roridin E和satratoxin H诱导的细胞毒性效应显著减弱。此外，分子对接分析表明，roridin E和satratoxin H对核糖体靶点具有高结合亲和力。用这两种真菌毒素处理导致关键内质网（ER）应激生物标志物表达增加，并激活未折叠蛋白反应（UPR）信号通路，涉及激活转录因子6（ATF6）、蛋白激酶RNA样内质网激酶（PERK）和肌醇需求酶1（IRE1）。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，roridin E和satratoxin H在黑色素瘤细胞中诱导ER应激介导的、caspase依赖性凋亡。这些结果凸显了这些大环单端孢霉烯族真菌毒素作为黑色素瘤治疗潜在候选药物的可能性。
